title: Norway supports CCUS development in Poland
summary: Poland is the largest recipient of EEA and Norway Grants for 2021-2028, with €924.9 million allocated, including €160.9 million through the Green Transition Programme. Gassnova is contributing Norwegian CCS expertise and experience to CCUS development in Poland under this programme.
why_it_matters: Norwegian support for Polish CCUS could shape future Baltic Sea CO2 source volumes and cross-border shipping demand towards North Sea storage.
approved_by: Published automatically (before the review step existed)
